# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang after Wall Street's worst week since 2020.](https://fiopoin.com/): Monday, November 23, 2026. US stock futures rose on Sunday night after Wall Street's worst week since 2020. Dow futures gained 798 points after the S&P 500 fell 8.6% last week. Taiwan had its worst week since 1991 and Korea's KOSPI fell 3.3% on Monday. Gold rose to $3,607.55.
- [Stocks and your savings: Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang as stocks try to bounce from the worst week since 2020.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and oil: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it hit US sites in Bahrain as the Houthis claim a Saudi refinery attack.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [Cybersecurity deal: CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler for about $43.9 billion in stock.](https://fiopoin.com/#deals)
- [Asian markets: Asia steadies after Taiwan's worst week since 1991, but Korea keeps falling.](https://fiopoin.com/#asia)
